restart: New Electron main reads exact persisted fixture descriptor; does not start a member
admissionControls: in-memory expected start-tick mismatch pauses with zero signals and zero new launches
cleanup: Open pidfds for both identities; revalidate PID/startTicks/UID/boot hash/nonce; signal only supervisor using pidfd SIGTERM; supervisor reaps its own child

failurePolicy: Persist incomplete result without native retry; owned Windows stage handles only; detached mocks self-expire as emergency backstop, never counted as verified cleanup
retention: Retain owned Linux fixture, host runtime and crash diagnostics; no recursive deletion
limits: Intentional detach is a controlled survivor, not natural provider survival
